note: Why → Summary. Recaps from Randy's own monthly reviews, refreshed November 16. Music: Google Doc 'Monthly Music Review', October 2026. Marvel: Marvel's Den → Behavior Log, October 2026 (saved November 9).

reviews.title: Music
reviews.gist: Less variety this month, but the sessions you felt called to produced things you liked. Vocals still feel like home. The challenge is connecting words, feeling and a track into something consistent.

points.label: Songwriting & vocals
points.text: The words are not the obstacle; connecting their meaning to the feeling and track is. The songwriting book is still there to work through.

points.label: Production
points.text: Experimenting with Ableton’s note shifting and splitting inside samples, and intervals between drums, bass and melody, has opened up new ways to layer sound. Sometimes less is more. Basslines and bass drops are areas you want to explore.

points.label: Guitar
points.text: Less present this month. Strumming and barre chords still need attention, but the amount of information is overwhelming while the basics and movements feel uncertain.

carry: Research guitar basics, strumming and barre chords

reviews.title: Marvel
reviews.gist: Not much of the plan was put into practice this month, but the structure is built. The next focus in your review is getting Marvel ready for his doggy DNA test.

points.label: Putting it into practice
points.text: The infrastructure is in place; October had limited follow-through rather than a new training breakthrough.

points.label: Behavior ratings
points.text: Moving calmly, waiting, energy and settling, whining, leash and stairs, and mouth manners were each rated 3/5 — getting there.

points.label: Needs more support
points.text: Being calm by himself and greeting people were each rated 2/5 — shaky.

carry: Get Marvel ready for his doggy DNA test

goalsIntro: Your goals across six areas. The names update live from the Life and Present Goals sheet; the one-line summaries were written Oct 8.

categoryGists.physical: Fuel, rest and care for your body: 170g protein, 3–4 bottles of water, whole foods, 7–8 hours of sleep, vitamins and self-care.
categoryGists.mental: A calm, aware mind: reading, journaling as reflection, daily Healthy Minds, clean spaces, and grounding/alignment reminders.
categoryGists.connection: Being present with people and with Marvel: plan lunches and experiences, be a villager in friendships, take pictures, train Marvel and audit monthly.
categoryGists.financial: Independence: build credit, grow your moving-forward savings, and snowball the material odds and ends to done.
categoryGists.spiritual: Creative expression and storytelling through guitar, vocals and production.
categoryGists.upkeep: Keep life running: home and possessions, digital systems, admin, money admin and personal logistics.
